import pandas as pd, numpy as np

S="guardian traveltime studytime schoolsup famsup activities higher romantic famrel freetime goout health paid failures".split()  # paid/failures subject-specific -> excluded below

def match(m,p):
    pairs=[]
    gm=m.groupby(K);gp=p.groupby(K)

    return pd.DataFrame(pairs,columns=['mi','pi','score','ambig'])
